messages:
alex: FYI customer reported a sudden p95/p99 latency regression after we onboarded redwood-clarion-v2 last night. They say p95 jumped to ~1.2s (from ~280ms) and p99 to ~4.8s (from ~760ms). Affected mainly long-context calls (>= 4k tokens) to /v1/chat, streaming off.

infra-bot: Deployment redwood-clarion-v2 (tag: rc-2026-03-12) completed at 2026-03-12T01:03:12Z :rocket:

alex: Minimal repro attached, example payload below. Root trace ids: trace=tr_0a1b2c3d, trace=tr_0f9e8d7c.
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-clarion-v2",
  "messages": [{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."}, {"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following 3k token doc..."}],
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "context_window": 4096,
  "stream": false
}
```

alex: Curl repro: 
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d @payload.json
```

liam: I'll take a look. Do we have token counts for these requests? is the tokenizer producing more tokens for the same text?

alex: customer logs show token count per request increased from ~3.1k -> ~4.2k on average for the same prompts after the new model. attaching quick metric: tokens_per_request 1.4x.

sophia: hmm — we shipped a tokenizer tweak for redwood-clarion-v2 that changed subword merges (emoji + punctuation handling). Could easily increase tokenization granularity and thus attention cost (O(seq^2) cost on some kernels).

liam: that explains compute increase, but the p99 -> 4.8s suggests batching + scheduling also amplifies. For long contexts we fall back to an unoptimized attention kernel for seq>2048 on some GPUs. Need profiler.

dave: Also saw autoscaler flapping around the same time (scale-up triggered then scaled down within cool-down window). That can cause head-of-line latency when requests hit a node that is still warming up (cold KV cache + cold CUDA context).

ops-oncall: Reproduced locally with the customer's prompt against rc tag. p95 ~1.3s, p99 ~5s. Collecting perf traces.

alex: logs (excerpt):
```
[2026-03-12T01:12:03Z] req=tr_0a1b2c3d model=redwood-clarion-v2 tokens_in=4200 inference_ms=4832 node=node-17 cache_hit=false kernel=matmul_fallback
[2026-03-12T01:12:04Z] req=tr_0a1b2c3d batch_size=1 kv_cache_load=150ms cuda_context_setup=420ms
[2026-03-12T01:12:05Z] req=tr_0a1b2c3d gen_ms=4010 token_emit_ms=820
```

liam: Kernel fallback + cache miss + cuda setup = obvious p99 components. Quick mitigation: force a compatible model variant that keeps old tokenizer (redwood-clarion-v2-compat) for affected customers, and enable prefix/KV caching. Also recommend enabling streaming for them as a UX improvement (reduces p99 for perceived latency).

sophia: Can confirm tokenizer patch increased token counts for punctuation-heavy docs and long sequences. We should revert the tokenizer change for the rc tag and run tokenization A/B metrics. I can roll a rollback to a patch that preserves old merges.

dave: Operational mitigations: 1) pin customer to clarion-v1 in their tenant config (fastest), 2) enable prefix caching (prefix_cache=true) for requests with repeated system prompts, 3) adjust autoscaler cooldown to avoid thrash while we investigate.

ops-oncall: Quick workaround issued to customer: pinned them to redwood-clarion-v1 and enabled prefix caching. Customer confirmed latency dropped back to baseline p95~320ms within 10 minutes.

alex: customer happy for now but wants root cause and a fix before full rollout.

liam: Action plan:
- liam: run kernel-level profiler on redwood-clarion-v2 with long sequences, collect CUDA timelines + nvprof. target by 2026-03-12 10:00 UTC.
- sophia: revert tokenizer changes for rc for now; run tokenization regression test suite and corpus token delta analysis. target by 2026-03-12 08:00 UTC.
- dave: monitor autoscaler events and extend cooldown for clarion pool; add alert if p95 > 800ms sustained. target immediate.

sophia: also will open an eval comparing tokenization per model across 1000 real docs, will post results in this thread.

liam: medium-term: need optimized long-context kernels or selective attention routing for seq>2048; I'll prototype selective tiling + kv-chunking to reduce fallback cases.

alex: FYI support ticket #SUP-11244 updated with mitigation and next steps. I'll coordinate with customer.

ops-oncall: added temporary dashboard card: model=redwood-clarion-v2, p95/p99, tokens_per_request, kv_cache_hit_ratio.

dave: tagging eng-ml and eng-runtime for postmortem. We'll need regression test coverage for tokenization-induced cost changes before future model onboards.

liam: I have a profiler run scheduled now. Posting trace when complete.

sophia: rolled back tokenizer commit from rc-2026-03-12 to rc-2026-03-10 for canary; will monitor token counts.

alex: thanks all — keeping thread open until we have root cause + fix for production rollout. :thumbsup:
